gen-gf-gabarito-gf-molengo: Gabarito draws every stroke with one marker-like nib, ends cut open. Molengo follows in a plain sans with wide gaps, so small text stays crisp beside that loose, expressive heading.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-momo-trust-sans: Expressive from the first word, Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open. Momo Trust Sans carries the paragraphs in a plain sans with heavy bowls and wide-mouthed curves, so a long page stays friendly and clear.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-mona-sans: Mona Sans reads as a plain sans with openings wide as a door left ajar, steady and businesslike. And Gabarito's single-weight, nib-drawn heading gives that restraint a distinctive voice to stand on.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-monda: Loose, friendly, and drawn with one nib, Gabarito has no thick-thin flicker to catch the eye in its headings. Monda keeps every small counter unclogged, so long text moves easily.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-mooli: Marker-drawn plainness, with open terminals that let each counter flow outward. Mooli answers with sans letters whose round, open forms stay crisp at small sizes, which is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-murecho: Gabarito has a bent-tubing look, drawn with one nib and terminals cut open so counters flow outward. And Murecho, a clean sans-serif whose s curves open wide at both ends, gives that expressive heading a modern, tidy partner.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-nanum-gothic: Nanum Gothic is a plain sans with wide channels leading into every counter. Gabarito does expressive, nib-drawn display work, while the body font simply gets on with reading.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-national-park: National Park is a clean, contemporary sans, drawn as if by a pen that never changes pressure, with rounded letters open on one side. Gabarito handles the headline personality with its open-cut terminals, and the body font handles steady reading.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-niramit: Niramit reads as crisp, professional sans-serif, its curves gaping open and its lines clean and tidy. Across a longer stretch it stays smooth and unfussy, which suits Gabarito's skimming heading.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-canadian-ab: Bars of identical thickness, loose and nib-drawn. Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal keeps every curve end open in a contemporary sans, so Gabarito's expressive headings sit above text that stays quietly readable.
